function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
It depends on a few things—your skin tone, the occasion, and the vibe you’re going for. Here’s a quick guide: | Factor | Cream‑colored clothes look best if… | |--------|-------------------------------------| | **Skin tone** | • **Cool undertones** – Cream can be a softer alternative to stark white, giving a gentle contrast without being too harsh.
• **Warm undertones** – Cream complements warm skin nicely, adding a natural, sun‑kissed glow. | | **Occasion** | • **Casual or daytime events** – Cream is relaxed and versatile; pair it with denim or khakis for a laid‑back look.
• **Formal or evening events** – Cream can be elegant, especially in a tailored blazer or dress. Pair with deeper neutrals (charcoal, navy) or metallic accents for a polished feel. | | **Color harmony** | • Cream pairs well with navy, charcoal, olive, burgundy, and soft pastels.
• Avoid pairing it with very bright neon colors; the contrast can feel jarring. | | **Season** | • **Spring/Summer** – Cream feels light and airy, great for breezy outfits.
• **Fall/Winter** – Cream can add warmth to a darker palette; consider layering with richer hues. | **Bottom line:** If you’re comfortable in cream and it matches the setting, go for it! It’s a neutral that can be both understated and stylish. Just keep the rest of your outfit balanced so the cream doesn’t feel out of place.
